gold_sql:
WITH ref AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-119.823195 36.752149)', 4326)::geometry AS g
),
nearest AS (
  SELECT r.road_name,
         r.geometry::geometry AS geom,
         ST_Distance(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-119.823195 36.752149)', 4326)::geography) AS dist_m
  FROM roads r, ref
  WHERE r.highway = 'cycleway'
    AND r.road_name IS NOT NULL
    AND ST_Dimension(r.geometry::geometry) = 1
    AND ST_NPoints(r.geometry::geometry) BETWEEN 2 AND 50
    AND r.geometry::geometry && ST_MakeEnvelope(-126, 24, -66, 50, 4326)
    AND ST_DWithin(r.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-119.823195 36.752149)', 4326)::geography, 100000)
  ORDER BY r.geometry::geometry <-> ref.g
  LIMIT 1
),
segments AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpSegments(n.geom)).geom AS seg FROM nearest n
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT ST_StartPoint(seg) AS p1,
         ST_EndPoint(seg)   AS p2,
         ST_Length(seg::geography) AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT e.seg_len_m,
         z1.v AS z1,
         z2.v AS z2
  FROM endpoints e
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p1) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p1)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z1 ON z1.v IS NOT NULL
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, e.p2) AS v
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, e.p2)
    LIMIT 1
  ) z2 ON z2.v IS NOT NULL
),
slopes AS (
  SELECT seg_len_m,
         CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m ELSE NULL END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT n.road_name,
       n.dist_m,
       DEGREES(ATAN(SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0))) AS slope_deg
FROM nearest n
CROSS JOIN slopes
WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY n.road_name, n.dist_m;

WITH zoo_geom AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-119.823195, 36.752149), 4326)::geography AS geometry
),
cycleway AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    geometry,
    ST_Distance(zoo_geom.geometry, roads.geometry) AS distance_to_zoo
  FROM 
    roads,
    zoo_geom
  WHERE 
    roads.highway IS NOT NULL
    AND roads.highway ILIKE '%cycleway%'
    AND ST_DWithin(zoo_geom.geometry, roads.geometry, 1000) -- limit search to 1000m
),
closest_cycleway AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    geometry
  FROM 
    cycleway
  ORDER BY 
    distance_to_zoo ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
terrain_profile AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_3DInterpolatePoints(
      ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, closest_cycleway.geometry),
      closest_cycleway.geometry,
      'LINESTRING'
    ) AS elevation_profile
  FROM 
    public.dem_us,
    closest_cycleway
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, closest_cycleway.geometry)
),
slope_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Slope(ST_Union(public.dem_us.rast), 1, '32BF') AS slope_rast,
    ST_Stats(ST_Slope(ST_Union(public.dem_us.rast), 1, '32BF'), 1, TRUE) AS slope_stats
  FROM 
    public.dem_us,
    closest_cycleway
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, closest_cycleway.geometry)
)
SELECT 
  'Fresno Chaffee Zoo' AS feature_name,
  MIN(cycleway.distance_to_zoo) AS distance_to_cycleway_meters,
  slope_stats.mean AS average_slope_degrees
FROM 
  cycleway,
  slope_stats;
